learning_outcomes.text: Know the procedure of systematic and method-supported product development.
Understand the connections between development and design and other departments of a developing and producing company.
Independently develop demanding products by applying the taught methods and adequate work techniques.
Understand the communication required for product development in a company.
Apply the knowledge to be a functional and social member of a project team.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental phases of the product development process
Requirements specification, functional specification, technical specification
Solution search and creativity techniques for finding solutions
Systematic preparation of solution approaches (morphology) and variation and combination techniques
Evaluation of concepts and concept selection
Creation of technical designs, preliminary design
Semester exercise for applying the learned material
assessment_rules: Assessment is based on a 90-minute written exam. A bonus system allows students to earn up to 10% additional points on the exam by completing and presenting tasks. There is no guarantee for the bonus system to be offered in a given semester.
